## ICallbackAnswerBlock type

Callback-answer block for Telegram inline-button feedback.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ICallbackAnswerBlock = {
    text: string;
};
```

## Remarks

Declared with `<g-callback-answer>` blocks. `text` supports the same `{{var|filter}}` interpolation pipeline as poll questions; the compiled value is length-checked at runtime before any API call (toast text at most 200 chars, plain text without HTML per the Bot API `answerCallbackQuery` limits).

## Example


```typescript
const answer: ICallbackAnswerBlock = {
  text: `Pesanan {{orderId}} diproses`
}
```
